```ruby
def slugify(title)
  title.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, "-").gsub(/\A-|-\z/, "")
end
```

It lowercases the title, turns each run of characters that aren't letters or digits into one hyphen, and trims hyphens from the start and end. Accented letters like "é" count as non-letters, so they become hyphens too.

To run the test: `ruby slugify.rb`. The test only runs when you run the file directly, not when another file loads it with `require`.
